job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Working for an established and growing business based in Wellingborough, Northamptonshire. With a turnover of approximately £3 million and exciting plans.  The company is looking for an experienced Accountant to take ownership of the day-to-day finance function.
Working closely with the business owner, this role offers plenty of autonomy and variety. It's a fantastic opportunity for someone who enjoys being involved in all aspects of finance, supporting business decisions, and becoming a trusted member of the team.

Accountant (ACCA, ACA, CIMA, AAT or QBE)
Wellingborough, Northamptonshire • Growing Local Business • Flexible Hours

Key Responsibilities
  • Month-end reporting
  • Cash flow management and reporting
  • P&L reporting
  • Producing Balance sheets
  • Producing the trial balance
  • Explaining financial information to the Managing Director
  • Accruals and prepayments
  • Maintaining the fixed asset register
  • Posting journals
  • Purchase ledger
  • Sales ledger
  • Bank reconciliations
  • VAT returns
  • Running BACS payments
  • Credit control
 
About You
  • ACCA, ACA, CIMA or AAT qualified, or Qualified by Experience (QBE)
  • Previous experience managing a broad finance role
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of the finance function
  • Confident communicating financial information to non-finance stakeholders
  • Strong organisational and problem-solving skills
  • Positive, proactive and practical approach
 
Other information
  • On-site parking
  • Friendly working environment
  • Opportunity to take ownership of the finance function
 
This is an excellent opportunity to join a successful local business where your contribution will be valued and where you can play an important role in supporting future growth.
If you'd like to find out more about this opportunity, we'd love to hear from you. Please contact Julie at Warner Recruitment for a confidential conversation. I look forward to hearing from you.

job.title: Accounts Assistant
job.description:
Are you an experienced Accounts Administrator who enjoys keeping things organised, building positive relationships with customers, and ensuring the finance function runs smoothly?
We're recruiting for an Accounts Assistant to join a well-established Northampton business in a varied role that combines credit control, purchase ledger, and day-to-day finance administration. You'll be responsible for helping keep accounts up to date, managing customer payments, resolving queries, and supporting the wider finance team with a range of accounting tasks.
This is a fantastic opportunity to join a stable, friendly team within a successful business that values reliability, teamwork, and a positive working environment. If you enjoy a busy role where no two days are quite the same, we'd love to hear from you.

Accounts Assistant
Northampton Full Time | Office Based Permanent

The Role
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing and maintaining the sales ledger
  • Chasing outstanding payments by phone and email
  • Building strong relationships with customers to resolve payment queries
  • Reducing aged debt and ensuring accounts remain within agreed terms
  • Processing supplier invoices
  • Supporting the purchase ledger function
  • Reconciling supplier statements
  • Assisting with account reconciliations
  • General finance administration
  • Supporting with year end and month end accounting
  • Supporting the wider finance team with ad hoc accounting duties as required
About You
We're looking for someone who:
  • Has previous experience in credit control, accounts receivable, or a similar finance role
  • Enjoys communicating with customers and building positive working relationships
  • Has good attention to detail and strong organisational skills
  • Is confident managing a busy workload and prioritising tasks effectively
Applications welcomed from Accounts Assistants, Assistant Accountants, Credit Controllers, Finance Assistants, and candidates qualified by experience or studying towards an accounting qualification.
What's on Offer?
  • Stable and successful business with a strong reputation
  • Friendly and supportive finance team
  • Varied role with responsibility from day one
  • Convenient Northampton location with excellent public transport links
  • Full-time, office-based position
  • Competitive salary and benefits package
If you're looking for a busy finance role where you can make a real contribution as part of an experienced team, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Accountant
job.description:
Are you an experienced finance professional looking for a flexible, project-based assignment? We are supporting a well-established business in Wellingborough that requires additional support within the finance function to assist with a number of important compliance, audit and process improvement projects.
Reporting to the Finance Director, this is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Accountant, whether professionally qualified (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent), AAT qualified or QBE. The successful candidate will enjoy investigating and resolving discrepancies, reconciling accounts, bringing records up to date and ensuring financial accuracy.

Temporary Finance Project Accountant (Part Time)
Key Responsibilities
You will be responsible for supporting a range of finance-related projects, including:
  • Reconciling retention payments, identifying amounts paid and outstanding
  • Assisting with a VAT-focused project, reviewing records and supporting compliance activities
  • Supporting a GDPR project, ensuring finance records and processes align with requirements
  • Assisting with risk assessment reviews and documentation
  • Supporting with audit project, gathering information and reconciling financial data
  • Producing accurate reports and findings for senior management
  • Working closely with the Finance Director to deliver project objectives within agreed timescales
About You
We would be pleased to hear from candidates who have:
  • Previous experience within a finance, accounting or audit-related role
  • AAT qualification, professional accounting qualification (ACCA, CIMA, ACA or equivalent), or strong finance experience gained through practice (QBE)
  • Excellent reconciliation and analytical skills
  • Strong attention to detail and a methodical approach
  • Good Excel skills
  • The ability to work independently and manage project-based workloads
  • Experience supporting compliance, audit, VAT or process improvement projects would be beneficial
The Opportunity
  • Temporary assignment for approximately 4-8 weeks
  • Flexible part-time hours, between 1 and 3 days per week (within office hours Monday-Friday)
  • Reporting directly to the Finance Director
  • Opportunity to make an immediate impact on several business-critical projects
If you are available for a short-term assignment and enjoy project-based finance work, we would love to hear from you.
If you would like to find out more about this opportunity, please apply and/or contact Julie at Warner Recruitment. We would be delighted to tell you more.
